disappeared. Wild-eyed, you rush through the hatchway and 
into the foggy gloom beyond. But, lurking on the other side, a 
hidden assailant sends a powerful blow to your head, and you 
sprawl to the deck. Barely conscious, you feel yourself picked up, 
swung unresistingly, and then hurled far over the side into the icy
